fields.summary_ko.0: CrowdStrike Holdings (CRWD) is a cybersecurity company with $246.8B market cap, up 62.7% over past year, significantly outpacing S&P 500's 8.2% gain.
fields.summary_ko.1: Of 50 analysts, 35 rate Strong Buy, 9 Hold, 3 Strong Sell; average price target of $255.34 implies 17.6% upside from current price.
